svg.text: Three parts of GitHub that work together on one project
A computer that GitHub runs for you, opened in a browser tab
Visual Studio Code in the browser. Nothing to install on the lab computer.
A computer GitHub runs for you,
with VS Code in a browser tab
A project folder on GitHub that keeps every version of your files
People invited to work on it
Publishes the files in a repository as a free website
Anyone on the internet can visit the website
No server needed. Free to host.
